TOOLTIPS.VISIBILITY: If Visibility is off the page will be available only for registered users.

PERSONALIZATION_ACCESS_CONTROL.TITLE: Personalization & Access control
PERSONALIZATION_ACCESS_CONTROL.DESCRIPTION: Limit page visibility to specific audiences

SCHEDULING.TITLE: Scheduling
SCHEDULING.DESCRIPTION: Set when this page should be visible

ALERTS.CLOSE_CONFIRMATION: You have unsaved changes. Close anyway?
ALERTS.DELETE: Are you sure you want to archive this page?

DELETE_SELECTED_CONFIRMATION.MESSAGE: Are you sure you want to archive {count} selected pages?

ALERTS.UNPUBLISH_WITH_DRAFT: Can't unpublish a page that has changes.

DESIGNER.TITLE: Designer: {name}
DESIGNER.SHARED_INFO: "{name}" is a shared component, used on {count} page(s). Editing it changes all of them.
DESIGNER.SHARED_MISSING: This shared component no longer exists. Remove it from the page.
DESIGNER.DETACH_HINT: Replaces it with a copy of its sections that only this page uses.
DESIGNER.PREVIEW_SLOW: The site is taking a while to load. Check that the storefront at {url} is running, then reload.
DESIGNER.NO_STOREFRONT: No preview: the site has no storefront URL. Set it in the site's Settings, then reopen the page.
DESIGNER.LOAD_FAILED: The page couldn't be loaded. It may have been deleted, or you may not have access to it.
DESIGNER.CONFLICT: This page changed while you were editing it. Reopen it to get the latest version; your changes weren't saved.
DESIGNER.NO_VERSION: This page can't be saved: its version is unknown. Reopen it and try again.
DESIGNER.DISCARD: You have unsaved changes. Close the designer anyway?
DESIGNER.CONFIRM_DISCARD_UNSAVED: Discard your unsaved changes? The page goes back to how it was last saved.
DESIGNER.EDITING_SHARED: You're editing a shared component: saving changes it on every page that uses it.

SHARED_PANEL.HINT: Sections you reuse across pages. Edit one to change it everywhere.
SHARED_PANEL.EMPTY: No shared components yet. In Sections, choose Select, tick the sections and save them as a shared component.

DESIGNER.ARCHIVED: This page is archived. Restore it to edit it in the designer.
DESIGNER.PROMOTE_FAILED: The page couldn't be promoted to production.
DESIGNER.PUBLISH_CONFLICT: Someone published another version of this page meanwhile. Publish your version over it?
DESIGNER.NOTHING_PUBLISHED: Nothing was published. Reopen the page to see the other version.

HISTORY.TITLE: Version history
HISTORY.EMPTY: No versions yet: save the page to make its first one.
HISTORY.SAVE_FIRST: Save or undo your changes first
HISTORY.CONFIRM: Make version {version} your draft? Publish it afterwards to put it live.
HISTORY.RESTORED: The version is now your draft
HISTORY.CONFIRM_DISCARD: Discard all unpublished changes? The page goes back to its published version.

THEME.TITLE: Theme
THEME.EMPTY: This theme has no settings to edit.
THEME.SAVE_FAILED: The theme settings couldn't be saved.

CLIPBOARD.COPIED: Copied: paste it on any page of the site
CLIPBOARD.PASTE_HINT: The browser didn't let the page read the clipboard: paste the copied content here.
CLIPBOARD.INVALID: The clipboard doesn't hold a copied section or block.
CLIPBOARD.BLOCK_NEEDS_SECTION: Select a section to paste a block into.
CLIPBOARD.BLOCK_NOT_ALLOWED: The selected section can't hold this block.

SELECT_MODE.SAVE_SHARED_HINT: The selected sections become a shared component: edit it once, and every page using it changes.
SELECT_MODE.NAME: Name
SELECT_MODE.SHARED_FAILED: The shared component couldn't be created.
SELECT_MODE.NOT_ADJACENT: Select sections that are next to each other.
SELECT_MODE.HAS_SHARED: A shared component can't hold another one: unselect it.

TEMPLATES.CREATE_HINT: The new template starts as a copy of the default one. Name it after the pages it's for, such as Printers; rules then decide where it's used.
TEMPLATES.NAME: Name
TEMPLATES.EXISTS: There's already a template with this name.
TEMPLATES.CONFIRM_SWITCH: You have unsaved changes. Switch anyway? They'll be lost.
TEMPLATES.IN_EFFECT_OTHER: On the site, {name} gets the {template} template. The preview shows the template you're editing.
TEMPLATES.NEW: This template isn't saved yet: until it's saved and published, the site shows its built-in layout.
TEMPLATES.TEMPLATE_HINT: Leave empty to let the template rules choose.

RULES.TITLE: Template rules
RULES.APPLIES_DEFAULT: This is the default template: it's used wherever no rule picks another one, so it needs no rules. For a different layout on some pages, create a template (copy of default) in the switcher and give it rules.
RULES.APPLIES_NONE: No rule picks this template yet. Add one, or use a suggestion below.
RULES.USE_FOR_HINT: Suggestions from {name} in the preview. A click adds the rule at the top of the list.
RULES.FIRST_MATCH: The first rule that matches wins. Drag to change the order.
RULES.EMPTY: No rules yet: everything uses the default template.
RULES.NO_TEMPLATE_HINT: The theme has no such template file: the site uses its built-in one if it has it, else the default.
RULES.TEST_WAITING: Pick what to preview with: the preview then tells which template the rules give it.
RULES.TEST_HINT: The site's published rules decide. Save and publish to test your changes.
RULES.JSON_HINT: The theme file {path}. Apply checks it and goes back to the list.

ERRORS.NOT_LIST: must be a list of rules
ERRORS.TEMPLATE: must name a {type} template, such as {type} or {type}.name
ERRORS.CATEGORY_IDS: must be a list of category ids
ERRORS.NAME_EQUALS: must have a name and an equals value
ERRORS.SOURCE: must be designer, file or blog

RULES.SAVE_FAILED: The template rules couldn't be saved.
RULES.NAME: Name
RULES.LANGUAGE_HINT: Such as de-DE, or de for every German locale
RULES.SOURCE_NOT_YET: The storefront doesn't check this one yet.
RULES.CUSTOM_HINT: Kept as it is. Change it in Edit as JSON.
RULES.NO_CONDITIONS: No conditions: the rule matches everything.

GIT.TITLE: Version history
GIT.CONFIRM_OFF: Turn off version history for this site? Pages will be saved to the platform's storage again. The repository and its history stay on GitHub.

HINT.OFF: Enable history to keep this site's pages in {repository}: every save is kept as a version, publishing merges it, and any earlier version can be restored.
HINT.MISSING: The site's repository doesn't exist yet. Enable history creates it.
HINT.ON: Every version of this site's pages is kept on GitHub. Turning history off takes the pages back to the platform's storage; the repository and its history stay.

SETUP.INTRO: Version history keeps every change to this site's pages, with who made it and when, so any earlier version can be restored. The pages are kept in a private GitHub repository of the site's own.
SETUP.CONFIGURATION: This platform takes its GitHub connection from its configuration, which isn't complete. Ask the platform's administrator to finish it.
SETUP.ORGANIZATION_HINT: Holds one private repository per site. Use a separate organization for each environment, such as acme-sites and acme-sites-staging.
SETUP.NEW_ORGANIZATION: No organization yet? Create one on GitHub
SETUP.STEP_CREATE: GitHub opens in a new tab with a Page Builder App for the organization. Select “Create GitHub App”.
SETUP.STEP_INSTALL: Install the App on the organization, with access to all repositories.
SETUP.STEP_RETURN: GitHub brings you back to the platform. Then open a site's History and select “Enable history”.

GIT.CONNECT_FIRST: This platform isn't connected to GitHub yet. Connect it once from the Sites panel, then turn history on here.

GITHUB.TITLE: GitHub
GITHUB.INTRO: Connect the platform to a GitHub organization once. Every site then keeps the versions of its pages in its own private repository there.
GITHUB.CONNECTED_HINT: Each site keeps its pages' versions in its own private repository in {organization}. Turn history on for a site from its History panel.
